hook.name: AgiV2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for graduated AGI v2 launchpad pools that collects a fee cut (hookFeeBps + creatorTaxBps) on every swap via afterSwap, deducting the fee from the pool manager's flash-accounting ledger and accruing it to per-pool pending balances, which can later be swept and split between protocol, buyback-and-lock vault, and creator.
